summary: Banco de Chile filed a Form 6-K attaching its third-quarter 2026 Financial Management Review press release for the period ended September 30, 2026, signed by CEO Eduardo Ebensperger. The exhibit is a routine quarterly earnings and management commentary document covering corporate governance, strategy, business environment, management discussion, and risk capital, prepared under CMF accounting standards and IFRS Management Commentary guidance. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. Watch for ordinary credit-quality, margin, and capital-ratio trends rather than deal terms.
